title: Output of the iteration-plan agent: a diagnosis and the decisions on the plan's sources of truth (the video prompt is recompiled from them)

dureeCoherente.description: Does the real file duration match the wanted duration (gap of half a second at most)? If false, no decision is applied. Always true without a thumbnail sheet (no real duration was measured).

symptome.description: (French) What is wrong, with the thumbnail instants (« à 4 s, l'épée apparaît »). Without a thumbnail sheet: the user's request restated in one sentence, no instants.

cause.description: (French) The precise cause targeted, only one. Points to a lexicon entry when one exists.

categorie.description: `decoupage-scenario` = the cause is outside this plan (other plans, their order). `modele` = the same symptom survived three corrections aimed at different causes (goes with `abandon.propose`). `autre` = a cause that fits no other category.

verification.description: (French) What to look at on the next render to know whether the decisions worked.

entreeLexique.description: (English) Optional. Lexicon candidate, to be entered only after a render that solved the symptom (never written by the application).

formulationQuiTient.description: The lever that held (a setting, a reference, a duration, or the intent sentence).

abandon.description: propose = true only if three corrections targeting different causes failed (see historique); otherwise propose = false and empty raison.

raison.description: (French) What was tried, and the proposed replacement move.

decisions.description: What changes on the plan. Each field REPLACES the plan's current value; empty / null = unchanged. The application recompiles the video prompt from these values and writes everything together.

nouvelleDescription.description: (French) Empty string = the intent stays. Otherwise the plan's NEW intent, COMPLETE: copy `plan.intention` word for word and change only what the instruction needs (the whole narrative in order, then the lines `NAME : « text »`, the `Consigne de l'auteur :` sentence if any). Never a fragment, never only the changed sentence; no camera words; no `État en fin de plan :` line.

dureeSecondes.description: null = the duration stays. Otherwise the new generation duration, whole seconds from 4 to 10.

ajouter.description: Registry codes of IMAGE assets to add as references (never invented, not already a reference). Six images at most in total.

retirer.description: Codes of the plan's current image references to remove (at least one image must remain).

manquants.description: At most 2 assets you SUGGEST to create because the cause is a missing image and NO registry asset fits (search first). Nothing is created: the user creates it, then iterates again. A STATE of a subject has the same type as the subject and its `parent`.

code.description: Proposed code, type prefix + short lowercase name (CHAR_, DEC_, PROP_, VFX_).

parent.description: Code of the base subject (registry) when the asset is a state of it.

description.description: (French) What is seen, as in the registry.

creativite.description: null = unchanged. Otherwise the plan's new creativity (one of `reglages.choix.creativite`).

styleMiseEnScene.description: null = unchanged. Otherwise the plan's new staging style (one of `reglages.choix.styleMiseEnScene`; `aucun` = no style).
